items.title: Szabina
items.subtitle: Her travels, in short posts.
items.body: Szabina travels and writes about it. After a trip she puts up a short post on her site: a title, a paragraph or two about the place, and the photos she took there. The site is static, hand-coded HTML. I added a small admin panel so she doesn't have to email me every time she wants to put up a new story. Hosted on GitHub Pages, which costs almost nothing to run.

items.title: VOEP
items.subtitle: Vintage outboard engine parts, online.
items.body: A 4,200-SKU WooCommerce build from zero. Custom child theme, tuned SKU search, IDEAL + Bancontact checkout, and a Mercedes-on-rails order pipeline. Built in roughly 60 hours of focused work. First sale within a week.
